name: Autonomous Product Evolution

observe.critical_finding: All feedback was simulated. No organic adoption exists.

learn.insight: Features without users is waste. Adoption infrastructure > feature development.
learn.root_cause: No README, no npm publish, no CI/CD, no documentation

pivot_decision.title: Pivot to Adoption Infrastructure
pivot_decision.rationale: 0 real users means features have no market. Must build adoption first.
changes: README overhaul with full API reference

lessons: Observe BEFORE building — real signals matter more than assumed needs
Zero users means zero market validation
README is the most important feature
Pivot decision must be based on data, not assumptions
Adoption infrastructure is a prerequisite for feature development
